sentences.text: Manemergus is a genus of polycotylid plesiosaur, a group of marine reptiles belonging to the family Polycotylidae.
The genus was described in 2005 and contains the single species Manemergus anguirostris. Its type specimen was discovered near the town of Goulmima in the High Atlas mountains of Morocco.
This animal lived in Morocco during the Late Cretaceous Turonian period, specifically between 93.9 and 89.8 million years ago.
